identificationModule.briefTitle: Andecaliximab With mFOLFOX6 as First Line Treatment for Advanced Gastric or Gastroesophageal Junction Adenocarcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3 Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of GS-5745 Combined With mFOLFOX6 as First Line Treatment in Patients With Advanced Gastric or Gastroesophageal Junction Adenocarcinoma

armGroups.label: Andecaliximab
armGroups.description: Andecaliximab plus mFOLFOX6 (LV+5-FU+OXA) during Cycles 1-6, followed by andecaliximab plus LV+5-FU during subsequent cycles

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: Placebo plus mFOLFOX6 (LV+5-FU+OXA) during Cycles 1-6, followed by placebo plus LV+5-FU during subsequent cycles

interventions.name: Andecaliximab
interventions.description: 800 mg administered intravenously on Days 1 and 15 of each 28-day treatment cycle

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Administered intravenously on Days 1 and 15 of each treatment cycle

interventions.name: Leucovorin
interventions.description: Administered intravenously per standard of care on Days 1 and 15 of each treatment cycle

interventions.name: 5-fluorouracil
interventions.description: Administered intravenously per standard of care on Days 1 and 15 of each treatment cycle

interventions.name: Oxaliplatin
interventions.description: Administered intravenously per standard of care on Days 1 and 15 of each treatment cycle
